subject: Can you review the Q4 pricing deck before Thursday?
summary: Priya asks Alex to review slides 4-9 of the Q4 pricing deck and comment by Thursday, November 26.
reason: A colleague is waiting on Alex's review, and leadership sees the deck the next morning.
body_text:
Hi Alex,

I've put the Q4 pricing deck in the team folder. Could you review slides 4-9 (the tier changes) and leave comments by Thursday, November 26? Leadership sees it Friday morning.

Thanks!
Priya
